# stb

Single-file libraries by Sean Barrett (https://github.com/nothings/stb),
unmodified, dual licensed public domain / MIT (the licence text is at the
end of each file).  Used by the NetSurf browser port:

- `stb_truetype.h` **v1.26** — parses TrueType fonts and rasterizes
  anti-aliased glyphs (`userland/netsurf/font_nova.c`);
- `stb_image.h` **v2.30** — decodes JPEG images, baseline and progressive
  (`userland/netsurf/jpeg_stb.c`).
